name: Apocalypse
overview: In this bold social experiment, a group of ordinary people is sent to an abandoned, apocalyptic-style town to survive for 28 days. Stripped of modern comforts like water, heating, and electricity, they must scavenge for food and supplies, repurposing whatever they find. With limited resources and the harsh environment, the contestants face the ultimate test of survival. Will they work together to overcome the challenges, or will the pressure cause them to crumble? It’s a gripping experiment in human resilience and teamwork under extreme conditions.
